issues.description: Obvious comment that adds no value
issues.rationale: Remove obvious comments. Code should be self-documenting.

issues.code_snippet:
def validate_email(email):
    return '@' in email and '.' in email
issues.rationale: DRY principle - function already exists in utils.validation module.

issues.description: Single-use wrapper class with no added value
issues.suggested_fix: # Remove class, use dict or dataclass directly
issues.rationale: Wrapper adds no validation, transformation, or business logic. Pure overhead.

issues.code_snippet:
def divide(a, b):
    return a / b
issues.rationale: Missing zero-check causes runtime error. AI-generated code often skips edge cases.

issues.description: Unnecessary singleton pattern for stateless utility
issues.suggested_fix: # Convert to simple function module - no class needed
issues.rationale: Formatter has no state. Singleton pattern is overkill. Use module-level functions.
